task_prompts.mm-validator--starts-with:
Add a new validator to marshmallow: `marshmallow.validate.StartsWith(prefix, *, error=None)`, which succeeds if the input string starts with `prefix`. Its default error message is `Must start with {prefix}.`; a custom `error` message may interpolate `{input}` and `{prefix}`. Examples of valid input: `StartsWith('ab')`: `'abc'`, `'ab'`. Examples of invalid input: `'xab'`, `''`.

Follow the conventions of the existing validators, include tests and a docstring, and add a changelog entry.
task_prompts.mm-validator--multiple-of:
Add a new validator to marshmallow: `marshmallow.validate.MultipleOf(base, *, error=None)`, which succeeds if the input number is an exact multiple of `base`. Its default error message is `Must be a multiple of {base}.`; a custom `error` message may interpolate `{input}` and `{base}`. Examples of valid input: `MultipleOf(3)`: `9`, `0`, `-6`. Examples of invalid input: `10`, `4`.

Follow the conventions of the existing validators, include tests and a docstring, and add a changelog entry.
task_prompts.mm-validator--unique:
Add a new validator to marshmallow: `marshmallow.validate.Unique(*, error=None)`, which succeeds if the input sequence has no duplicate elements. Its default error message is `Must not contain duplicates.`; a custom `error` message may interpolate `{input}`. Examples of valid input: `[1, 2, 3]`, `[]`, `['a', 'b']`. Examples of invalid input: `[1, 2, 1]`, `['a', 'a']`.

Follow the conventions of the existing validators, include tests and a docstring, and add a changelog entry.
task_prompts.mm-validator--hexadecimal:
Add a new validator to marshmallow: `marshmallow.validate.Hexadecimal(*, error=None)`, which succeeds if the input is a non-empty string made only of hexadecimal digits (`0-9`, `a-f`, `A-F`, no prefix). Its default error message is `Not a valid hexadecimal string.`; a custom `error` message may interpolate `{input}`. Examples of valid input: `'deadBEEF'`, `'0'`. Examples of invalid input: `'0x1f'`, `''`, `'xyz'`.

Examples of invalid input: `'main.pyc'`, `''`.

task_prompts.mm-validator--ip-address:
Add a new validator to marshmallow: `marshmallow.validate.IPAddress(version=None, *, error=None)`, which succeeds if the input string is an IP address; `version` may be `4` or `6` to accept only that version (the default `None` accepts both). Its default error message is `Not a valid IP address.`; a custom `error` message may interpolate `{input}` and `{version}`. Examples of valid input: `'127.0.0.1'`, `'::1'`. Examples of invalid input: `'256.0.0.1'`, `'localhost'`.

Follow the conventions of the existing validators, include tests and a docstring, and add a changelog entry.
task_prompts.mm-validator--not-blank:
Add a new validator to marshmallow: `marshmallow.validate.NotBlank(*, error=None)`, which succeeds if the input string contains at least one non-whitespace character. Its default error message is `Field may not be blank.`; a custom `error` message may interpolate `{input}`. Examples of valid input: `'a'`, `' x '`. Examples of invalid input: `''`, `'   '`, `'\t\n'`.

Examples of invalid input: `'abc'`, `['y']`.
